tips_en: Start with DiffusionART (Paper 1) — it offers the most impactful practical result (12× fewer GPU hours vs. DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast) and a clear theoretical insight about the hidden consistency force in NFT-style training. All three papers share an RL thread: DiffusionART uses online policy optimization for generative models, Reflex applies PPO with motion priors to whole-body humanoid control, and EmbodiedCLBench evaluates continual/skill-learning in embodied agents — so reading them in this order naturally progresses from efficient RL training to RL-driven control to RL-based agent evaluation.
tips_zh: 建议先读 DiffusionART（第1篇）——它在效率上成果最显著（相比 DiffusionNFT 和 Flow-GRPO-Fast 节省 12 倍 GPU 小时），并提出了关于 NFT 式训练中隐藏一致性力的清晰理论洞见。三篇政策均围绕强化学习展开：DiffusionART 将在线策略优化用于生成模型，Reflex 用 PPO 结合动作先验实现人形机器人全身控制，EmbodiedCLBench 则评估具身智能体中的持续/技能学习，按此顺序阅读可自然地从高效 RL 训练过渡到 RL 驱动的控制，再到基于 RL 的智能体评估。
